# Code Anchors: Epic Stub

- `libs/delivery-config/src/keys.ts` — declares the unplanned-label row's builtin default: `needs-refinement`, renamed in place from `backlog` so a repository with no override picks up the new value automatically.
- `libs/epic-resolve/src/classify.ts` — resolves the unplanned label across the process seam and answers whether an epic issue still carries it.
- `libs/epic-resolve/src/resolve.ts` — refuses to materialize an unplanned epic by name rather than emitting one with an empty story set.
- `libs/epic-resolve/src/resolve.spec.ts` — pins the refusal and the label resolution against the resolver's fixtures.
- `components/commands/nxs.epic.md` — the decomposition writer: files one stub issue per functional goal behind the right-size gate's consent, and promotes by issue number with no slug lookup; the approval gate's deferral writer files one stub for asked-for scope the reviewer declined, recording its number back onto the draft, and skips the step entirely when planning a one-story deferral; the discovery entry mode files through this same writer, adding the decision gists to each stub body and a marked comment after filing.
- `components/commands/nxs.close.md` — the deferred-scope writer: files stub issues as the first step after the closure checkpoint, before the close record naming their numbers is committed.
- `docs/features/README.md` — the features index carrying the single link to the cross-feature backlog query.
- `libs/delivery-config/src/story-filer/stub-parent.ts` — the parent check that lets a stub be a sub-issue of an initiative and refuses every other parent, the whole batch at once, before anything is created.
- `libs/delivery-config/src/story-filer/labels.ts` — the ported label establishment: every label the run will apply exists before the first create, and one that cannot be established stops the run.
- `libs/delivery-config/src/story-filer/configure.ts` — filing-defaults doc comment naming this contract, kept in step with the renamed term.
- `libs/delivery-config/src/epic-filer/args.ts` — the `--promote` usage line naming this object by its current term.
- `libs/epic-resolve/src/gh-fixtures.ts` — the fixture graph's `unplanned-label` field, faking the resolver's answer in tests without a live repository.
- `components/commands/nxs.intake.md` — a third writer of kept follow-ups, filing through this same batch path after its own approval gate.
